one_liner_ko: 소설 쓰기에 맞춘 AI 글쓰기 파트너.
what_it_does_ko: Sudowrite는 소설가를 위한 AI 글쓰기 도구로, 소설 전용 AI 모델 Muse를 내세운다. Story Bible이 아이디어에서 개요, 챕터, 본문까지 단계별로 이끈다. 다음 문장 이어 쓰기, 장면 확장, 묘사, 다시 쓰기, 피드백 기능으로 초고와 퇴고를 돕는다. 1,000개 이상의 플러그인으로 원하는 기능을 더할 수 있다.
use_cases_ko: 한 해에 여러 권을 내는 작가의 작업

pricing.free_tier: 무료 체험 있음 (카드 불필요, 한도 불명)

evidence.quote: Sudowrite - Best AI Writing Partner for Fiction
Sudowrite is the non-judgemental AI writing partner you always wanted.
Muse 1.5, our AI model built just for fiction
Story Bible takes you step-by-step from idea, to outline, to beating out chapters, to 1,000s of words, in your style .
It analyzes your characters, tone, and plot arc and suggests the next 300 words in your voice.
Expand magically builds out your scenes so the pacing doesn’t take readers out of the story.
Feedback gives you five actionable areas to improve.
Explore plot points, character arcs, and themes in a magic AI canvas.
Visualize brings your character sheets and worldbuilding documents to life with art generated from your descriptions.
Over 1,000 new ways to get inspired, master your craft, and make your process joyful.
Write a novel from start to finish. FAST .
Perfect for people who write for fun or for school
For authors who publish multiple times a year
Good for longer works, like a novel or screenplay
